creativetab.noblephantasms.title: Noble Phantasms
jei.noblephantasms.info.andvaranaut: Equip in a Curios ring slot. Mob loot drops are doubled, but all damage you take is doubled.
jei.noblephantasms.info.ankh: Equip in a Curios charm or compatible totem slot. Fatal damage restores full health, releases a damaging and blinding radiant burst, and grants 15 seconds of invulnerability. Reborn prevents another activation for 2 minutes.
jei.noblephantasms.info.bia_en_pet: Melee strikes ignore the target's armor while still respecting shields, enchantments, effects, absorption, and immunity frames.
jei.noblephantasms.info.clydno_halter: Use on a horse to fit the halter and receive its bound Recall Bell. Ring the bell anywhere to summon the horse. Sneak-use the bell on that horse to recover the halter.
jei.noblephantasms.info.draupnir: Carry Draupnir to generate gold every 30 seconds. Equip it in a Curios ring slot to make piglins treat you as though you are wearing gold armor.
jei.noblephantasms.info.eagle_knight_tal: Crouch while airborne to dive rapidly. Landing creates a 4-block shockwave that deals more damage the farther you fell, while negating the slam's fall damage.
jei.noblephantasms.info.eye_of_horus: Equip in a Curios necklace slot. Hold your crosshair on a living target for 2 seconds to apply Judgement for 15 seconds, marking it with a golden glow and making it take 25% more damage from all sources. Judged enemies you kill have a chance to drop glowing Eye Shards. Up to six pieces grant 5% damage and reduce gaze time by 0.25 seconds each. At six pieces, the next fully charged Judgement marks nearby enemies in a radiant burst.
jei.noblephantasms.info.gram: Every third fully charged damaging hit against a hostile or neutral target triggers Fafnir's Bite, adding damage that scales with how much the target's maximum health exceeds yours.
jei.noblephantasms.info.holy_grail: Drink to gain Undying for 5 seconds. Damage cannot reduce you below half a heart while it lasts. 3 minute cooldown.
jei.noblephantasms.info.hofskor: Equip in a Curios charm slot. Your horse gains 40% speed, two-block step height, and immunity to fall damage while ridden.
jei.noblephantasms.info.kazaguruma: Right-click to throw the chained sickle up to 12 blocks. It damages and hooks the first living target struck, then pulls the target into melee range. 3 second cooldown.
jei.noblephantasms.info.kheper_scarab: Equip in a Curios charm slot. Repairs each damaged item in your hands and armor slots by 1 durability every 2 seconds.
jei.noblephantasms.info.macuahuitl: Hits apply Bleeding for 5 seconds. Repeated hits add up to 5 stacks, with each stack dealing 1 armor-bypassing damage every second.
jei.noblephantasms.info.medju_netjer: Use Medju Netjer on an enchanting table to install it. Sneak-right-click the table with an empty hand to remove it. While installed, it reveals enchantment offers and lets you reroll them for 1 Lapis Lazuli.
jei.noblephantasms.info.meginjord: Equip in a Curios belt slot. Grants +4 melee damage, increased knockback and upward launch, 50% block-breaking speed, and immunity to environmental movement penalties.
jei.noblephantasms.info.pridwen: Raise the shield to project a wide barrier that protects allies behind you. Melee attackers recoil and suffer Weakness.
jei.noblephantasms.info.raiko: Use to beat the drum and call lightning at the point you are looking at within 40 blocks. 5 second cooldown.
jei.noblephantasms.info.scabbard: Equip in a Curios belt slot. Constantly regenerates health faster as your health falls and prevents poison, wither, and bleed effects.
jei.noblephantasms.info.scales_of_maat: Right-click a living target to set your health percentage and theirs to their average. Bosses can lose at most 10% of their maximum health per use. 30 second cooldown.
jei.noblephantasms.info.smoking_mirror: Use on a living target to make every mob within 10 blocks hunt it for 8 seconds.
jei.noblephantasms.info.tyrfing: Drawing the sword grants tremendous attack damage and speed, but it cannot leave your hand until you kill a living target. After a kill, you have 4 seconds to put it away before the curse binds it again.
jei.noblephantasms.info.weben: Charges for 10 seconds while carried in direct sunlight. A fully charged strike releases a fiery flare for bonus damage and ignites the target.

noblephantasms.configuration.title: Noble Phantasms Configs
tooltip.noblephantasms.andvaranaut.flavo: Andvari's ring brought its owners a great hoard and a curse; each inheritor gained the treasure and paid in blood.
tooltip.noblephantasms.ankh.flavor: This hieroglyph meant life; gods were often shown placing it at a pharaoh's lips to grant life's breath.
tooltip.noblephantasms.bertilak.flavor: The axe's namesake is revealed as the Green Knight, who claims the right to return Sir Gawain's axe blow and the right to his head...
tooltip.noblephantasms.bia_en_pet.flavor: Tutankhamun was buried with a dagger of meteoritic iron—a metal fallen from the sky in an age of bronze.
tooltip.noblephantasms.carnwennan.flavor: Welsh tradition calls Arthur's dagger the 'Little White Hilt'; later retellings let it shroud him in shadow.
tooltip.noblephantasms.clydno_halter.fla: One of Britain's Thirteen Treasures, its keeper found within it whatever horse he wished for.
tooltip.noblephantasms.draupnir.flavor: Every ninth night, Odin's golden ring dripped eight more rings of equal weight from itself.
tooltip.noblephantasms.eagle_knight_talo: Elite Mexica warriors wore eagle-shaped war suits, invoking a predator that kills in its descent.
tooltip.noblephantasms.excalibur.flavor: Malory wrote that Arthur's drawn blade shone in his enemies' eyes with the light of thirty torches.
tooltip.noblephantasms.eye_of_horus.flav: Thoth restored Horus's wounded eye from scattered pieces, and the completed wedjat became a sign of protection and wholeness.
tooltip.noblephantasms.gjallarhorn.flavo: Heimdall's horn will be heard through every realm when it calls the gods to Ragnarok.
tooltip.noblephantasms.gram.flavor: Sigurd reforged his father's shattered sword, then slew Fafnir by thrusting upward from a pit beneath the dragon.
tooltip.noblephantasms.gungnir.flavor: Odin's dwarf-forged spear was so perfectly made that no throw could miss its mark.
tooltip.noblephantasms.heka.flavor: As royal regalia, the crook cast the pharaoh as shepherd and guardian of his people.
tooltip.noblephantasms.holy_grail.flavor: Across medieval romances, the sacred vessel granted sustenance, healing, and divine grace.
tooltip.noblephantasms.hofskor.flavor: Old Norse hoof-shoes were protective fittings for a steed; these bear molten signs of impossible swiftness.
tooltip.noblephantasms.hulioshjalmr.flav: In Norse saga, a 'concealing helmet' could mean not armor, but the very magic that made someone unseen.
tooltip.noblephantasms.kazaguruma.flavor: Kusarigama wielders used the weighted chain to entangle a weapon or limb before closing with the sickle.
tooltip.noblephantasms.kheper_scarab.fla: Scarab amulets invoked Khepri, whose rising sun renewed itself each morning.
tooltip.noblephantasms.kusanagi_no_tsuru: Yamato Takeru escaped a burning field by cutting down the grass and turning the flames with the wind.
tooltip.noblephantasms.macuahuitl.flavor: Mesoamerican warriors lined wooden weapons with inset obsidian blades, whose brittle edges cut even as they splintered.
tooltip.noblephantasms.medju_netjer.flav: Hieroglyphs were 'words of the god,' sacred signs believed to carry the power they described.
tooltip.noblephantasms.meginjord.flavor: Thor's 'power-belt' doubled his already immense strength whenever he fastened it.
tooltip.noblephantasms.nekhakha.flavor: Paired with the crook, the royal flail represented the pharaoh's power to drive, discipline, and command.
tooltip.noblephantasms.pridwen.flavor: Welsh tradition numbers Arthur's broad shield among the arms that guarded him and those who stood at his side.
tooltip.noblephantasms.raiko.flavor: Raijin is encircled by drums whose thunder calls lightning down with every beat.
tooltip.noblephantasms.rhongomyniad.flav: Geoffrey of Monmouth calls Arthur's lance hard, broad, and fit for slaughter—the weapon he carried in the charge at Badon.
tooltip.noblephantasms.scabbard.flavor: Malory valued Arthur's sheath above the sword itself, for its wearer could not lose a drop of blood.
tooltip.noblephantasms.scales_of_maat.fl: Spell 125 of the Book of the Dead weighs the deceased's heart against Ma'at's feather.
tooltip.noblephantasms.smoking_mirror.fl: The god from whom it takes its name carried an obsidian mirror for divination and embodied change through conflict.
tooltip.noblephantasms.uchide_no_kozuchi: In the tale of Issun-boshi, a stolen ogre's mallet grants wishes with a swing and restores the tiny hero to full size.
tooltip.noblephantasms.tyrfing.flavor: The dwarfs Dvalinn and Durinn cursed their sword so that once drawn, it could not be sheathed before taking a life.
tooltip.noblephantasms.weben.flavor: The Egyptian verb behind its name described the sun in the act of rising and shining.
tooltip.noblephantasms.yamawari.flavor: The child hero Kintaro was famed for superhuman strength and traditionally shown carrying a broad masakari axe.
